title: Seagrove "A Place in the Sun" 235 Lake Vista Lane
h1: Seagrove "A Place in the Sun" 235 Lake Vista Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gulf views- Deeded beach access directly across the street- Private pool **Pool heating available Oct 1 through May 1 for $45 per day**- 4th Floor lookout tower with Gulf view- Walkable distance to The Greenway Station- Shopping and Food- 6 Seater Low-Speed Vehicle Included - 2 car Garage- Professionally decorated- Plantation shutters throughout home- 4 adult bikes- Commercial icemaker located in garage (never worry about ice for your cooler again!)- Outdoor shower- Complete Clean Linen Participant- ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Welcome to “A Place in the Sun”, located conveniently near the white sand beaches of Seagrove! This 4-story home features 4 bedrooms, 4 full ensuite bathrooms, and 2 half-bathrooms to accommodate a total of 10 guests comfortably. This home is just a 4-minute walk to a deeded beach access and includes a 6 seater golf cart to make your journey around 30A a little more adventurous! The home has a private pool with outdoor living area, lounge chairs and a 65-inch flat-screen TV poolside.This professionally designed home begins with a screened-in porch on the first floor and a queen bedroom with a shower-only ensuite bathroom. This level also offers a half bath that is convenient to the pool area and screened-in porch.The second level is the main area of the home which features an open concept kitchen, a living area that flows seamlessly to the second-floor balcony, and includes a 75-inch flat-screen TV. There is also a half bathroom on this floor. The dining area can seat up to 11 people utilizing the seating at the breakfast bar. A built-in butler’s pantry/cocktail bar with a wine fridge is also located on this level. There is also a bedroom with a king bed and a private bathroom.The third level of the home features the primary bedroom with a water view balcony, king bed, and a private bath with a separate tub and shower. There is another king bedroom with private bath along with an XL Twin-over-Twin built-in bunks in the hallway. The laundry room is also located on this level.The rooftop observation deck has gorgeous views of the Gulf and is a signature feature of this home.“A Place in the Sun” is located in East Seagrove Beach at the junction of 30A and Eastern Lake Drive. This is a great location for access to shops, dining, bars, boutiques, and outdoor concerts.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTSFIRST FLOOR:-Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower Only-Half BathroomSECOND FLOOR:-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower/Tub Combo-Half BathroomTHIRD FLOOR:-Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub Separate-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower/Tub Combo-Hallway Bunk Area: XL Twin-over-Twin Bunk bed*Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments as well as be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.
